answer: A farm needs 396 separate DARK proofs, since each commitment is bound to its own polynomial. The commitment is verified against the public parameters, and the opening is checked each epoch. The lotus is the wall and the ocean is the gate: DARK commits to polynomials transparently, so no trusted setup is needed for the proof. A farm of 396 aliases must climb the wall 396 times, the fable ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
